lines.zh: 我沿着界碑走，碑上的字磨平了。
lines.en: I walk the boundary stones; their carvings wore away.

lines.zh: 脚步落在石上，浅浅一层光。
lines.en: My steps leave a shallow glow on the stone.

lines.zh: 这条巡逻路线，早没人记得。
lines.en: No one remembers this patrol route now.

lines.zh: 我走得很直，因为界不能歪。
lines.en: I walk straight; a boundary must not bend.

lines.zh: 雾气跟着我，像一件旧斗篷。
lines.en: Mist follows me like an old cloak.

lines.zh: 地底的脉动，我一脚一脚数。
lines.en: I count the pulse underground, step by step.

lines.zh: 这里曾经有一道门，我还在门前走。
lines.en: A gate once stood here; I still walk before it.

lines.zh: 我的影子是淡的，落不到地上。
lines.en: My shadow is faint and never quite lands.

lines.zh: 脚下的裂缝，我也要绕开看一遍。
lines.en: I walk around the cracks to check them once more.

lines.zh: 走过第七圈，我会停一下。
lines.en: After the seventh round, I pause.

lines.zh: 光从我肩头漏下来，像沙。
lines.en: Light leaks off my shoulder like sand.

lines.zh: 我踩过的地方，草会长得慢些。
lines.en: Grass grows slower where I have stepped.

lines.zh: 我站着，边界也站着。
lines.en: I stand, and the boundary stands.

lines.zh: 身上的纹路一亮一暗，像呼吸。
lines.en: The lines on me brighten and dim like breathing.

lines.zh: 我在等一声不会再来的钟。
lines.en: I wait for a bell that will not ring again.

lines.zh: 我的名字被划掉了，剩下职位。
lines.en: My name was struck out; the post remains.

lines.zh: 风穿过我，带走一点光。
lines.en: Wind passes through me and carries off a little light.

lines.zh: 我数过界碑，一共七块。
lines.en: I have counted the markers: seven in all.

lines.zh: 手里的长杆，已经不分是杖是枪。
lines.en: The pole in my hand is neither staff nor spear now.

lines.zh: 我试着想起脸，想起来的是门。
lines.en: I try to recall a face and remember a door.

lines.zh: 这条界线，我闭着眼也能描出来。
lines.en: I could trace this line with my eyes closed.

lines.zh: 旧版本的誓言，还在生效。
lines.en: An outdated oath is still in force.

lines.zh: 石缝里的苔藓，比我活得热闹。
lines.en: The moss in the cracks lives louder than I do.

lines.zh: 我抬头，天上没有星。
lines.en: I look up; there are no stars.

lines.zh: 没人来换岗，我就一直在这。
lines.en: No one comes to relieve me, so here I stay.

lines.zh: 光暗下去时，我数自己的骨节。
lines.en: When the light fades, I count my own joints.

lines.zh: 我把长杆立在石缝里，扶着。
lines.en: I plant the pole in a crack and lean on it.

lines.zh: 远处有钟声，我分不清真假。
lines.en: A bell rings far off; I cannot tell if it is real.

lines.zh: 你身上没有界印，怎么进来的？
lines.en: You bear no boundary mark; how did you enter?

lines.zh: 我数完你的步子，才开口。
lines.en: I counted your paces first, then spoke.

lines.zh: 你的名字，我念不出来。
lines.en: I cannot pronounce your name.

lines.zh: 活人走近界碑，总要先摸一摸。
lines.en: The living always touch the marker first.

lines.zh: 你眼里的光，和我守的不是一种。
lines.en: The light in your eyes is not the kind I keep.

lines.zh: 站住，让我对一遍界的走向。
lines.en: Stand still; let me check the line's course.

lines.zh: 你能看见我，说明界线松了。
lines.en: That you can see me means the line has loosened.

lines.zh: 我认得你这副骨架，却想不起名字。
lines.en: I know that frame of yours, but not the name.

lines.zh: 你的脚印越过了石头，我记下了。
lines.en: Your print crossed the stone; I have noted it.

lines.zh: 别怕我。我怕的是没人来。
lines.en: Do not fear me. I fear that no one comes.

lines.zh: 你身后那扇门，你看不见吧。
lines.en: That door behind you: you cannot see it, can you?

lines.zh: 我在你脸上找旧人的影子。
lines.en: I search your face for the shadow of someone old.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸把雾吹开了。
lines.en: Your breath pushes the mist aside.

lines.zh: 看着我，我需要被记住一次。
lines.en: Look at me; I need to be remembered once.

lines.zh: 光被打散了一角，又聚回来。
lines.en: A corner of my light scatters, then gathers back.

lines.zh: 这一下穿过我，落在后面的石上。
lines.en: That passed through me and struck the stone behind.

lines.zh: 你的手劲不小，界晃了一下。
lines.en: Your arm is strong; the line wavered.

lines.zh: 我不流血，只掉下一些光点。
lines.en: I do not bleed; I shed flecks of light.

lines.zh: 疼是旧感觉，我快忘了。
lines.en: Pain is an old sensation I nearly forgot.

lines.zh: 纹路断了半根，还连得上。
lines.en: One line broke; it can still be joined.

lines.zh: 我退了一步，界跟着缩了一步。
lines.en: I stepped back, and the line shrank a step.

lines.zh: 你打中的是我，不是界。
lines.en: You struck me, not the boundary.

lines.zh: 这一下让我想起了上一次。
lines.en: That blow reminded me of the last time.

lines.zh: 我还在，说明界还没破。
lines.en: I am still here; the line holds.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，只吃边界上的杂音。
lines.en: I do not eat; I take the noise off the boundary.

lines.zh: 这块东西，对界没有用。
lines.en: That thing is of no use to the boundary.

lines.zh: 你举着它，像举给一个空位。
lines.en: You hold it up as if to an empty place.

lines.zh: 放下吧，我已经很久不饿了。
lines.en: Set it down; I stopped being hungry long ago.

lines.zh: 我的身体是光做的，不缺粮。
lines.en: My body is made of light; it lacks no grain.

lines.zh: 你在贿赂一个职位，不是我。
lines.en: You are bribing a post, not a person.

lines.zh: 收了你的东西，界就不清了。
lines.en: Were I to take it, the line would blur.

lines.zh: 我认得这味道，是旧年的供品。
lines.en: I know that smell; it is an old year's offering.

lines.zh: 你留着，路上会用得上。
lines.en: Keep it; you will need it on the road.

lines.zh: 别在我面前晃，界线会记下你。
lines.en: Do not wave it here; the line will remember you.

lines.zh: 你穿过来一点，界就麻一下。
lines.en: A little of you crosses, and the line goes numb.

lines.zh: 别贴在界碑上，碑会烫。
lines.en: Do not lean on the marker; it heats up.

lines.zh: 我没有重量，撞开的是光。
lines.en: I have no weight; what you push is light.

lines.zh: 这一下，把雾撞散了一圈。
lines.en: That scattered the mist in a ring.

lines.zh: 你撞我，等于撞一道墙的影。
lines.en: You struck me, which is striking a wall's shadow.

lines.zh: 退开半步，别踩过线。
lines.en: Half a step back; do not cross the line.

lines.zh: 我的肩是虚的，你的肩是实的。
lines.en: My shoulder is hollow; yours is solid.

lines.zh: 碰一下，我身上的纹路亮了。
lines.en: One touch, and the lines on me light up.

lines.zh: 你站的地方，正是界最薄处。
lines.en: Where you stand is the thinnest part of the line.

lines.zh: 别推，我退了，门就开了。
lines.en: Do not push; if I step back, the door opens.

lines.zh: 戍卫不成家，只守门。
lines.en: A warden takes no household, only a gate.

lines.zh: 我曾等过一个人，门没等到他。
lines.en: I waited for someone; the gate never received him.

lines.zh: 这副形体是光，抱不住什么。
lines.en: This form is light; it cannot hold anything.

lines.zh: 界不认亲缘，只认位置。
lines.en: The boundary knows no kin, only positions.

lines.zh: 你若要留下后代，别留在界上。
lines.en: If you would leave descendants, do not leave them on the line.

lines.zh: 我记不住名字，更记不住承诺。
lines.en: I cannot keep names, much less promises.

lines.zh: 我的职位比命长，比情也长。
lines.en: My post outlasts my life, and outlasts affection.

lines.zh: 门口只有我一个人，一直如此。
lines.en: I am alone at the gate, as always.

lines.zh: 别对我许诺，我活得太久了。
lines.en: Do not promise me anything; I have lived too long.

lines.zh: 牵我的手，会摸到光。
lines.en: Take my hand, and you will feel light.

lines.zh: 这块石头有界的纹，我收下。
lines.en: This stone bears a boundary mark; I keep it.

lines.zh: 我捡起掉落的界签，插回土里。
lines.en: I pick up a fallen marker and plant it again.

lines.zh: 碎片归位，界线才连得上。
lines.en: Only when the shards return does the line connect.

lines.zh: 这盏灯该挂在门柱上。
lines.en: This lamp belongs on the gatepost.

lines.zh: 我拾起旧币，它已经没有用处。
lines.en: I pick up an old coin; it is useless now.

lines.zh: 你的东西掉了，我放到石头上。
lines.en: You dropped this; I set it on the stone.

lines.zh: 我收着它，等失主回来。
lines.en: I keep it until its owner returns.

lines.zh: 有用的留着，没用的埋进界下。
lines.en: The useful stay; the rest go under the line.

lines.zh: 我拿东西不留痕，光会盖住。
lines.en: I leave no print when I take; light covers it.

lines.zh: 这一小片布，是旧袍子的。
lines.en: This scrap of cloth came from an old robe.

lines.zh: 界线动了。有人越过来了。
lines.en: The line moved. Someone has crossed.

lines.zh: 你的脚印在石上，抹不掉。
lines.en: Your footprints are on the stone; they will not fade.

lines.zh: 我看见你踏进第七块界碑。
lines.en: I saw you step past the seventh marker.

lines.zh: 这个位置原本不该有活物。
lines.en: Nothing living should stand in that spot.

lines.zh: 目标确认，界的缺口就是你。
lines.en: Target confirmed: you are the gap in the line.

lines.zh: 我抬起长杆，雾就散开。
lines.en: I raise the pole, and the mist parts.

lines.zh: 你身上的热，把界烧出了一个洞。
lines.en: Your warmth burned a hole through the line.

lines.zh: 我等你很久了，不是等你这一个。
lines.en: I have waited long, though not for you alone.

lines.zh: 别走了。再往前，界就收不回来。
lines.en: Stop. One step more, and the line cannot close.

lines.zh: 我的手抬起来时，光会跟着。
lines.en: When my hand rises, the light follows.

lines.zh: 你听见的那声低鸣，是我在定位。
lines.en: That low hum you hear is me taking your measure.

lines.zh: 越界的人，都要被问一次。
lines.en: Anyone who crosses must answer once.

lines.zh: 我慢慢挪过去，界跟着我走。
lines.en: I drift forward, and the line moves with me.

lines.zh: 你退，界就往前压。
lines.en: You retreat, and the line presses forward.

lines.zh: 我不跑，光不需要跑。
lines.en: I do not run; light has no need to.

lines.zh: 长杆点地，声音传到碑上。
lines.en: My pole taps the ground; the sound reaches the markers.

lines.zh: 你在往界外走，正好。
lines.en: You are walking outward; that suits me.

lines.zh: 我把缺口补在你身后了。
lines.en: I have sealed the gap behind you.

lines.zh: 雾越来越厚，你还能看清路吗？
lines.en: The mist thickens; can you still see the road?

lines.zh: 你不用回头看，我就在侧后。
lines.en: No need to look back; I am at your side-rear.

lines.zh: 界的范围，比你想的小。
lines.en: The boundary is smaller than you think.

lines.zh: 我抬起手，纹路朝你那边亮。
lines.en: I lift a hand, and the lines brighten toward you.

lines.zh: 再走三步，你就站在线上了。
lines.en: Three more steps, and you stand on the line.

lines.zh: 我数着你的步子，不快不慢。
lines.en: I count your steps, neither fast nor slow.

lines.zh: 这条旧规矩，我背得很熟。
lines.en: I know this old rule by heart.

lines.zh: 长杆横扫，带起一圈光。
lines.en: The pole sweeps wide, trailing a ring of light.

lines.zh: 这一下不重，只是把你推回线内。
lines.en: That was light; it only pushed you back inside.

lines.zh: 我的手掌贴上来，很凉。
lines.en: My palm presses against you, and it is cold.

lines.zh: 光从杆头射出，像一记短鞭。
lines.en: Light snaps from the pole's tip like a short whip.

lines.zh: 你越线一步，我就打一下。
lines.en: One step over, one strike from me.

lines.zh: 我不追打，只把你赶回去。
lines.en: I do not chase; I only drive you back.

lines.zh: 骨节碰在你肩上，声音是空的。
lines.en: My joints strike your shoulder with a hollow sound.

lines.zh: 这一击留着分寸，下次不会。
lines.en: This blow was measured; the next will not be.

lines.zh: 界线在我脚下亮起，你别碰。
lines.en: The line lights at my feet; do not touch it.

lines.zh: 我抬手，雾就替你挡了一下。
lines.en: I raise my hand, and the mist shields you once.

lines.zh: 有人念了旧命令，我就来了。
lines.en: Someone spoke the old command, so I came.

lines.zh: 这具身体本不该再出现。
lines.en: This body should not appear again.

lines.zh: 零点九八之后，门就关了。
lines.en: After zero ninety-eight, the gate closed.

lines.zh: 我用刷怪蛋被叫醒，很轻的一声。
lines.en: A spawn egg woke me with a small sound.

lines.zh: 界还在，我就还得站着。
lines.en: The boundary remains, so I must stand.

lines.zh: 我睁开眼，先看脚下的线。
lines.en: I open my eyes and check the line at my feet.

lines.zh: 光从土里浮起来，慢慢有了形状。
lines.en: Light floats up from the soil and slowly takes shape.

lines.zh: 配置里还有我的名字，所以我还来。
lines.en: My name is still in the config, so I still come.

lines.zh: 没人记得这个位置，石头记得。
lines.en: No one remembers this post; the stones do.

lines.zh: 我回来时，门柱已经塌了一半。
lines.en: I return to find half the gatepost fallen.

lines.zh: 还是这身旧光，还是这条界。
lines.en: Still this old light, still this same line.

lines.zh: 召我的人，你站得离界太近了。
lines.en: Whoever called me, you stand too near the line.

lines.zh: 我以为再也不会醒来。
lines.en: I thought I would never wake again.

lines.zh: 上岗之前，我先数一遍界碑。
lines.en: Before taking post, I count the markers once.

lines.zh: 火穿过我的身体，照亮了骨头。
lines.en: Fire passes through me and lights up my bones.

lines.zh: 我从高处落下，落地没有声响。
lines.en: I fall from height and land without a sound.

lines.zh: 水漫过我，光在水里散成丝。
lines.en: Water rises through me; my light frays into threads.

lines.zh: 冲击把雾掀开，露出了界碑。
lines.en: The blast peels back the mist and shows the markers.

lines.zh: 箭穿过去，钉在后面的界碑上。
lines.en: The arrow passes through and sticks in a marker.

lines.zh: 这咒和我的界同源，很刺耳。
lines.en: This spell shares my line's source, and it grates.

lines.zh: 我不需要粮食，界替我活着。
lines.en: I need no grain; the line keeps me alive.

lines.zh: 雷落在界碑上，我替它接了一半。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the marker; I take half of it.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有界可守，我空着。
lines.en: The void has no boundary to keep; I am empty.
